searchQueries.title: Search queries (Algolia)
searchQueries.description: Free text queries against Hacker News via Algolia. Example: vector database, open source crm, alternative to notion. Case insensitive. Leave empty if only using firehose feeds below.

feeds.title: Firehose feeds (optional)
feeds.description: HN lists to pull alongside search queries. Valid values: new, top, best, ask, show, jobs. new returns the latest submissions. top/best rank by score. ask/show/jobs are the category pages.

keywords.title: Keywords (client side filter)
keywords.description: Only items whose title or text contains any of these keywords are kept. Case insensitive. Leave empty to keep everything the search or feed returned.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: What Algolia search returns. Stories is submissions only. Comments is only comment bodies. Both pulls from both endpoints.

sortBy.title: Sort
sortBy.description: Newest returns the latest matches first. Popularity ranks by HN points and Algolia relevance.

maxAgeHours.title: Max age in hours
maxAgeHours.description: Skip items older than this many hours. 0 keeps everything regardless of age.

minScore.title: Minimum points
minScore.description: Skip stories with fewer than this many HN points. Comments have no score, so this is ignored for comments.

minComments.title: Minimum comments
minComments.description: Skip stories with fewer than this many comments. Ignored for comment results.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per query or feed
maxItemsPerSource.description: Per source cap. Algolia pages contain up to 1000 results total via pagination.

maxItemsTotal.title: Maximum items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on items pushed to the dataset per run. Controls cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip HN item IDs pushed on previous runs. Stored in the key value store under SEEN_IDS. Turn off to return every match on every run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. HN and Algolia endpoints are fully public and do not require a proxy, but add one if your schedule triggers rate limiting.
